title: 📊 Daily Report: Wed Nov 18, 2026
text:
Swing book: $17,412.88 (since merge -$2,607.86 vs Indy/SPY -$1,243.94, a gap of -$1,363.92; book -13.03% vs SPY -6.21%). This week vs the Nov 14 base: -$349.25 (CORE -$316.54, strategies -$32.71). Indy bench: $18,778.74.
Bots that traded today: none (0 trades; the swing desk sat out because SPY is below its 200-day average). CORE QQQ: ON under the month-end rule (Oct 30 close 690.49 vs 200-day 678.37), held at $10,434 (60% of book, vol-scale x0.64); no CORE trade on the box today. Since the Nov 16 switch: CORE -0.87%, old daily rule 0% (in cash), SPY -2.44%.
Benched bots (Trek, Rota, Sunny): 2 real positions open across the book still running off; shadow trade counts (on-time vs late) are not broken out in today's summary, so I can't give them.
Research's analyst note (2026-11-18): Mixed close (Nasdaq +0.4%, S&P -0.2%, Dow -1.1%) on hawkish Fed minutes; NVDA fell a fifth day despite a beat. Retail beat-and-raise worked: TGT idea +2.6% from the open, TJX held its +8% gap and its conditional entry triggers at today's close. The LOW avoid looked wrong (reversed to +1%); the chip-group avoid holds through tomorrow. PANW (open idea) is up about 7% after hours: hold. Next: Anthropic IPO trades Thursday; WMT, BABA, PDD report pre-open, INTU and ROST after the close; about 95% odds of a December Fed hike.
Desktop shadow: DIFFERENCES: 1 desktop-only (CORE QQQ BUY 0.5866 @ 662.09 at 9:32 AM, "rebalance to 62%"), 4 matched, 0 DIFF, 0 box-only. Code versions MATCH (20261117-2143-22447ef493c3 on both, updater current). Desktop heartbeat 6 min old. The box's first market-hours tick landed at 9:34 AM, after the desktop's 9:32 trade, and the box logged no CORE trade today, so this likely lines up with the box's pre-open pause (last gap ended 9:29 AM; 20 catch-up ticks) but I could not confirm that from the logs. Flagging for review.
Change note (2026-11-18): The strategy test now counts every cost (slippage, sell fees, late-wake price loss) and keeps the bar at its original level; no strategy passes yet. A fresh set of untouched market days starts today and stays sealed until about mid-May 2027, and the tuner can change settings at most once a month. The practice Alpaca account has margin and shorting off and now copies our non-CORE trades as a check (its $100k balance does not drive decisions). Broker-side stops gained full safety tests and stay off.
Engine timing: no slips (first tick 9:34 AM, ticks every minute through 3:45-3:52 PM). No CORE skips.

Claude impact: Batch b20261118-013114 (Nov 17) advised the broker-stops width is reasonable (edge-case tests added, stops stay off), a reset and 1x-margin, no-shorting paper account mirror (margin/shorting done and mirror ON with stops off; reset not done, we kept the $100k account), and ranked ideas: finish the SPY alpha gate and use a sealed holdout (both adopted, bar kept at 2.5), an always-on host (desktop shadow under way), slippage calibration and a point-in-time universe (later). Effect so far: too early to measure; the first mirror session stayed in sync but hasn't yet copied a real engine trade.
